stem:
Tushar paints $\dfrac{1}{6}$ of a wall in one hour. Pallavi paints $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of the same wall in one hour. They work together on that wall.

Which claim correctly combines their work?

options.text: Keep only one individual rate as the answer, without combining the two hourly amounts.
The finishing time is what produces each painter's individual rate.
Add the hourly amounts: $\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{3}=\dfrac{1}{2}$ of the wall per hour, so together they finish in $2$ hours.
Multiply $\dfrac{1}{6}$ by $\dfrac{1}{3}$ as if inverse proportion alone settled the shared task.

teacher.key_rationale: For one shared task, add the work each person completes per hour. Combined rate 1/2 wall per hour means 2 hours for the whole wall.
